evidence: Carries the Mining label and modifies src/node/miner.h, src/node/block_template_manager.{h,cpp}, and src/rpc/mining.cpp to manage block template metrics.
rationale: Fixes inaccurate mining statistics reporting in getmininginfo and eliminates thread-unsafe global state. As noted in the description, 'the mempool fee estimator builds its own templates with BlockAssembler, so getmininginfo can report the fee estimator's template instead of the last mining template,' and moving these fields to BlockTemplateManager resolves this cross-subsystem contamination while progressing issue #33758.
